description: This file defines a utility class 'TrackingAreaSupport' with a static method 'resetMouseTracking' that manages NSTrackingArea objects for NSView instances, enabling mouse event tracking within a specified view.

classes.name: TrackingAreaSupport
classes.description: Utility enum providing static methods for managing mouse tracking areas on NSView objects.

methods.name: resetMouseTracking
methods.description: Resets the mouse tracking area for a given NSView by removing the current tracking area and adding a new one with specified options.
parameters: view: NSView - the view to update tracking for
tracking: inout NSTrackingArea? - the existing tracking area to be replaced
owner: AnyObject - the owner of the tracking area, typically self

calls: NSTrackingArea(rect: view.bounds, options: options, owner: owner, userInfo: nil)
